subject: Pico Park
title: What is Pico Park? The co-op game behind Sonic Pico Park
answer: Pico Park is a cooperative puzzle-platformer from the Japanese indie studio TECOPARK in which every player must work together to reach the goal. It first came out on Steam on April 26, 2016. A Sonic the Hedgehog version, Sonic Pico Park, launches Nov. 12, 2026, for 2 to 8 players.
body:
In Pico Park, players control small, identical characters, and no one can finish a stage alone: the group has to cooperate to solve each puzzle and reach the goal. The game later came to Nintendo Switch. The current version supports 2 to 8 players, and the free Classic Edition supported up to 10. Wikipedia credits a developer known as Teco as its designer, programmer and artist, and estimates the game has sold more than 230,000 copies. A sequel, Pico Park 2, came out on Switch on Aug. 27, 2024, and on PC and Xbox on Sept. 12, 2024.

The free Pico Park: Classic Edition was pulled from the Steam store on June 14, 2026, after TECOPARK announced its removal on June 1.

Sonic Pico Park, also written "SONIC PICO PARK," blends the series with Sega's Sonic games: every character can use Sonic's Spin Dash, and stages add rings, loops and springs. Players reach the goal plate at the right side of each stage. It releases Nov. 12, 2026, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam), with local and online play and online cross-play.
in_the_news: Sonic Pico Park, a Sonic the Hedgehog take on the Pico Park co-op series, releases on Nov. 12, 2026.

faq.a: TECOPARK, an indie developer from Japan.

faq.q: How many players can play Sonic Pico Park?
faq.a: Two to eight players, locally or online, with cross-play.

faq.q: When does Sonic Pico Park come out?
faq.a: Nov. 12, 2026, on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch 2, Switch and PC.

faq.q: Can you play Pico Park alone?
faq.a: Pico Park is designed for 2 to 8 players working together; the original Classic Edition supported up to 10.
The free Pico Park: Classic Edition was removed from Steam on June 14, 2026. The main Pico Park and Pico Park 2 are paid games.
